Current measured assessment — 2026-10-07

Public decoded diagnostic implemented and tested on JVM and JS, with independent augmented-QR output oracle and attempted/refused denominator. Source/receipts: docs/verification/phrf-checkpoint-20261007/README.md, branch work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007 based on 9ba2c57f (hosted Gale d03eb99b). PHRF-33 remains NOT ADMITTED and open; no full B0/performance/scientific pass or finite-state activation.

Measured blockers: dense basis compiler refuses 2,727,270 training cells above 2,000,000. Explicit BlockedPartial(96) admits unchanged rank 10/tolerance/domain. Under frozen eight-node bank/two-jet baseline, exact and corrected modes emit 0/256: 93 budget and 163 curvature refusals. Expanded six-step/eight-jet budget still emits 0/256; an explicit 27-node bank plus that budget emits 5/256. N=1,200 lowering refuses 7,200,000 convolved-term cells above 4,000,004. Original-equation evidence still refuses before reads. Current small samples are diagnostic, not throughput qualification; phase timing/memory/full denominators remain incomplete.

Next bounded work: resolve shape initialization/refinement admission against a dense same-model oracle before throughput tuning, preserve terminal/refusal semantics; make stress-case lowering bounded; integrate PHRF-11 original-equation evidence; then run full frozen checkpoint and make the activation/engineering decision. Old discarded-jet/fixed-truth component timings no longer say the complete gate passed. Do not treat a larger grid/budget as an accepted freeze change.
